title.tr: Yeşil çatılı kamelya, kafes panelli alçak duvar, toprak zemin
title.en: Green-roofed gazebo with a lattice-panel half wall on bare soil

alt.tr: Yeşil çatılı sekizgen kamelya, kafes panelli alçak duvar ve çevresinde toprak zemin, yanda servi ağacı
alt.en: Green-roofed octagonal gazebo with a lattice-panel half wall, bare soil around it and a cypress tree at the side

caption.tr: Alçak duvarın üst kısmı açık, alt kısmı kafes panellerle örülü. Zemin henüz toprak halinde.
caption.en: The upper part of the half wall is open and the lower part is filled with lattice panels. The ground is still bare soil.
